notablePrerequisites:
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
You have a way to draw a card.
You control a mana-producing land.
description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Trespasser's Curse, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
